hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Yarli, an extinct Pama-Nyungan language subgrouping with Baagandji, is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 (**hh:w:Morton:NWNSW**, **hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**, **hh:hvw:HercusAustin:Yarli:2004**, **hh:b:Austin:Malyangapa**, **hh:w:CrozierDewhurst:Evelyn-Creek**).
